title: Radiant Heat Material Transfer Studio
description: A material experimentation studio where a glowing pot of coals radiates heat that dynamically alters the material properties of a nearby silk pouf. The user adjusts the distance between objects, coal intensity, and environmental factors to observe how heat proximity transforms the pouf's specular response, color absorption, roughness, and subsurface scattering in real time across multiple controlled steps.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a Radiant Heat Material Transfer Studio. Load PotOfCoals.glb and SpecularSilkPouf.glb using GLTFLoader. Place the pot of coals on the left and the silk pouf on the right on a dark metallic ground plane. Camera: perspective at (0, 2.5, 5) looking at origin, with OrbitControls. Lighting: one dim ambient light (0x1a1a2e), one warm point light (0xff6600) parented to the coal pot that pulses subtly in intensity. Add a subtle HDR-like environment using PMREMGenerator with a simple procedural gradient for reflections on the silk. Create a GUI panel (HTML/CSS overlay, no dat.gui) with these interactive controls that each validate input ranges: (1) a slider 'Coal Intensity' (0.1–3.0) that adjusts the point light intensity and adds an emissive glow to coal meshes; (2) a slider 'Proximity' (0.5–4.0) that moves the pouf closer or farther from the coals; (3) a dropdown 'Heat Response Mode' with options [Scorch, Warm Glow, Frost Contrast] that changes how the pouf material reacts — Scorch increases roughness and shifts color toward brown, Warm Glow adds orange emissive and reduces roughness for sheen, Frost Contrast increases metalness and shifts to cool blue tones; (4) a slider 'Specular Intensity' (0.0–2.0) controlling the pouf material's specular/reflectivity; (5) a checkbox 'Enable Subsurface Simulation' that when active blends a translucent reddish backlight behind the pouf simulating heat penetration; (6) a 'Capture Snapshot' button that logs current parameter values to a visible on-screen results log. The pouf's MeshPhysicalMaterial properties (roughness, metalness, color, emissiveIntensity, sheenColor, sheen) must update reactively based on a computed 'heat factor' derived from coalIntensity divided by proximity. Validate all slider values are within range before applying. Animate coal emissive with a sine-wave flicker. Add a subtle particle system (small orange sprites) rising from the coals. The results log should display at least the last 3 snapshots with timestamps.
